top_categories.workout_context: King Price Race to Sun's South African mountains, Multi-stage forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 100 miles.
At mile 60 of 100, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
King Price Race to Sun's south African mountain gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic King Price Race to Sun's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
When someone attacks on south African mountain gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of King Price Race to Sun. Train it until it feels boring.
At King Price Race to Sun, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 100 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At King Price Race to Sun, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
100 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,281ft of climbing on south African mountain gravel does to your power file on race day.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on south African mountain gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for King Price Race to Sun’s 100 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at King Price Race to Sun requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on south african mountain gravel to build confidence. Expect: south african mountains, multi-stage, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, Durability, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 100 miles of south african mountain gravel in South Africa.
